Premier League managers from across the country have reacted to the news that the Premier League charged Manchester City with more than 100 alleged breaches of financial regulations and has referred the findings to an independent commission.

The charges relate to a nine-year period from 2009 but City say they are "surprised" and "welcome a review of this matter".
